title: New interview begins with Myra Menville
summary: A new speaker states her name and birth date, and the opening question about first hearing New Orleans jazz is asked.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: Myra Walmsley Loka. My name now is Myra Menville. I was born August the 16th, 1912, and I love jazz. Now you want to try that back and see if you can get it?
When do you think you first became aware that there is such a foreign music as New Orleans Jazz?
